Hi Sarah / Tom,

Thanks again for taking the time today — great conversation. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we're aligned: 

- Key pain: high per-request latency and inconsistent tail latencies on peak routes.
- What we heard: need predictable p99s for routing and stronger cost controls for peak-hours.
- Success criteria (what we'd aim to prove in the technical deep-dive): a) 2x reduction in p99 on your 95th-percentile requests, b) clear unit-cost estimate with a recommended batching/quantization profile.

Next steps:
1) Technical deep-dive / demo with our Solutions Engineer (Nikhil) — 60 min. I proposed a placeholder calendar invite for 2026-06-09 at 11:00am PT.
2) Share a short mutual action plan (attached) and a tech-reqs template for your infra team to fill ahead of the deep-dive.

I attached the mutual action plan (Discovery_MAP_v1.pdf) for your review. If you didn't receive the calendar invite or if that time doesn't work, tell me which of these windows would be best for you and I'll update the invite:
- 2026-06-09 11:00am PT / 2:00pm ET
- 2026-06-09 3:00pm PT / 6:00pm ET
- 2026-06-10 10:00am PT / 1:00pm ET

Apologies if the invite comes through with the wrong timezone — we're based in PST and sometimes the default calendar settings get applied. I'll double-check the link if you don't see the invite.

Thanks,
